blurb: Capital Clubhouse offers ice skating, sport court activities, rock climbing, and event hosting in a 90,000 square foot facility. They provide programs, leagues, private lessons, birthday parties, and corporate/community event spaces. The facility includes an NHL-size ice rink, a multi-sport court, rock climbing wall, locker rooms, party/meeting rooms, concessions, and a fitness center.
extraNote: $500 down and 5 equal installments due monthly after registration for programs · $150 discount for full payment at registration for all programs except 8U · All birthday parties must be scheduled at least 2 weeks in advance · No outside food permitted at birthday parties except birthday cake · Year round
